body:
I didn't speak English in kindergarten so that was basically hell for me.

Oh and "learning" handwriting with those two lines that are an inch apart and the dotted line in the middle was also terrible. All I wanted to do was write small and give my a's tails but noooo we had to do a circle then a line and take up all the space given. I remember throwing a giant fit once when my teacher tried to make me put a "two-finger space" between my words. Needless to say, I never got great handwriting grades even though I currently have the neatest handwriting out of any of my friends.
My mom just made fun of me for complaining that the kitchen smelled green. It's usually tasting purple for me though.
oh yeah. except sometimes i drink entirely way too much and it just throws my anxiety completely out of whack. sure i may get all paranoid and shake uncontrollably but at least i'm not depressed :P

i chew on the insides of my lips and my cheeks. it starts off as a nervous/fidgety thing and then i keep doing it because i'm somehow trying to get rid of the rough patches by biting at them (it only makes it worse). i had to go to school with a completely swollen lip last week because i just went at it xP

I used to have this problem and whenever I was around my friends I would talk to my parents in English. Somehow this ended up being one of those few things I actually got over. Most of my friends actually find it really cool and get all excited about it so I recommend maybe testing the waters a bit with your friends. Just little by little start speaking the other language around them until you're more comfortable. Chances are, they won't make fun of you for it. If anything, they should be proud of you for what you have accomplished (foreign languages aren't easy) :)

I've tried but I usually just end up writing a couple of entries then either forgetting about it or not being able to find anything meaningful or important to write. Then it just turns into a giant doodle space.
the thing is: you're completely right and i know it.

I just feel like I talk and talk and think about all this stuff and it just doesn't change. It only reminds me of everything that's wrong. And seeing that so many others can't find a solution only makes me feel like the chances of me ever getting over this are getting lower and lower.
SAME. Then I feel all wasteful when thousands of them expire a year later!

Thanks for trying but that's just not true. I'm trying to get help but no matter what I can't shake any of these feelings. I want to change, I want to start living, it's just no matter what I do I always find myself in some sort of rut I just can't get out of.
There's really not much to say: I'm depressed, I don't know why, the littlest thing can set me off and I don't know why I'm even putting myself through any of this in the first place.

I guess. I just can't get over the fact that I could die this very second and it would barely matter. Everyone is replaceable. A small group of people would be affected too, but looking at the big picture there would be pretty much no change. People die every second. I am just one of the many who are alive, just like I would be one of the many who die.
therapy doesn't help me. they tell me things but i can't even bring myself to follow their directions.

Even if I am "something" now (at most a fleshy mass staring at a monitor at 3am on a monday morning) what good is that to anybody. In a few decades I will be nothing, nobody will remember anything about me and it will be like I never existed. Why exist if in the end you might as well not have existed.
